hero.title: Your files, on your own server.
hero.lede: CloudStore is a self-hosted file storage and sharing app. Upload and organise files, share them with other accounts or with a link that lasts 24 hours, all stored in an S3 bucket you control.
hero.licence: Open source under the MIT licence.
hero.sample: Sample files. Screens show the CloudStore web app.
hero.previewLabel: The CloudStore file list showing a reports folder with five items, their sizes, dates and public links.

features.title: Everything a file server needs, and nothing you have to trust someone else with.
features.lede: Files go to your bucket. Accounts, shares and the activity log live in your Postgres database.

upload.title: Upload and sort into folders
upload.body: Drag files in, make folders, rename and download. Folders are stored as key prefixes in S3, so the bucket stays readable outside the app too.

share.title: Share with the people who need it
share.body: Give another CloudStore account access by email. It shows up under Shared with me, and you can see who has access and remove it at any time.

links.title: Public links that switch themselves off
links.body: Need to send a file to someone without an account? Create a public link. It stops working 24 hours later, so old links don't leave files open.

trash.title: Deleted by mistake? It's in Trash.
trash.body: Deleted files wait in Trash for 30 days. Restore them any time before that. A nightly cleanup removes anything older.

activity.title: See what happened, and when
activity.body: Every upload, rename, share, link and delete is written to your activity log, so you can check what changed in your files.

built.title: How it's built
built.lede: A Spring Boot API and a Next.js app, in one repository you can read end to end.

api.detail: Files, sharing, public links and the activity log, grouped by feature.

auth.detail: Short-lived access tokens with refresh tokens; accounts verified by an emailed code.

links.detail: Each link stores its own expiry and stops resolving after 24 hours.

cleanup.detail: A scheduled job at 02:00 removes items deleted more than 30 days ago.

storage.detail: File contents in Amazon S3; accounts, shares, links and activity in PostgreSQL.

frontend.detail: React and TypeScript with one API client that refreshes tokens on a 401.

ci.detail: Frontend tests run on every change, and the build fails if coverage drops.

selfHost.title: Run it on your own server
selfHost.lede: You need Docker, a PostgreSQL database, an S3 bucket and an SMTP account for verification emails.
selfHost.step2Body: Put your database, S3 and mail settings in backend/.env, and the API address in frontend/.env.local.

close.title: Keep your files where you can see them.
close.body: Create an account on this server, or set up your own.
